meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

copy.tagline: 跟着引导完成首次配置,顺畅跑通核心工作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触这个工具,想快速知道从哪一步开始。
copy.tagline_en: Walk through first-time setup and get the core workflow running
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to this tool and unsure where to begin.

howto.what: Claude 会作为引导者，按顺序带你走完 omo 首次会话的六个环节：功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值映射、贯穿全程的记忆记录，以及首次会话的 init-deep 提议；其中三个环节是自愿选择，你拒绝就直接跳过。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用 omo 时触发。它每次安装只自动启动一次，之后可用 omo --onboard（或 senpi --onboard）调起。

say.text: 我想开始用 omo，带我过一遍。
我原来用 Claude Code，能帮我把配置迁过来吗？
say.note: 先列出迁移计划，等你确认。

say.text: 帮我看看我以前的编码会话记录。

howto.what_en: Claude guides a new omo user's first conversation through six lanes in order: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording (throughout), and a first-session init-deep proposal. Three lanes are opt-in.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once per install; afterward it can be brought back with omo --onboard or senpi --onboard.

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo, walk me through it.
say_en.note: Runs the six lanes in order.

say_en.text: I came from Claude Code — can you migrate my setup?
say_en.note: Shows a plan and waits for your yes.

say_en.text: Look through my previous coding-agent sessions.
